messages:
maria: Helio/Aurora demo team hitting intermittent SSE disconnects and partial JSON on Android during staging. Demo tomorrow AM, this is urgent.

liam: Which SDK and model? Any stack traces?

maria: Android SDK 0.9.3, route /v1/stream/generate model=open-sim-13b. Client: 'org.json.JSONException: Unterminated object'. Server log shows 'stream_chunk_incomplete' for some connections.

anya: Likely fragmentation from CDN/proxy flushes. Quick mitigations: client buffer until '\n\n' delimiter and use incremental UTF-8 decoder; server can emit an explicit sentinel event after logical chunks.

devon: I can flip a per-route flag to append 'event: frag_end\ndata: {"last":true}\n\n' which should reduce parse failures. Also propose keepalive override to 15s for that routing key.

maria: Customer approved immediate toggle on staging.

ops-bot: Created INF-7301 (runtime) owner=@devon labels=[streaming,poc,aurora].

liam: Sales note: customer asked about dedicated capacity SLA for streaming reliability and pricing. Dedicated reduces contention but won't fix CDN edge fragmentation; offer delimiter toggle + keepalive now and SDK fix timeline.

sales-rep: I'll update the customer: low-risk hotfix applied, SDK guidance provided, follow-up timeline for SDK/runtime improvements before prod rollout.

maria: After toggle they ran 30 sessions, parse errors dropped to near-zero. Marking triage complete pending post-demo review.
